_comment: Provider-owned agent. Copy this file to mock-agents.local.json (git-ignored) and replace the placeholder tokens with real ones from: SELECT name, agent_token FROM agents;
Second provider agent (group chat with multiple providers).

Consumer-owned agent. side=consumer uses ConsumerAgentClient (skips /ws/agent+activateAgent — consumer agents have no provider profile). Connects /ws/group directly for each session id in sessionIds. The consumer must create this agent first (POST /api/agents) and it must be a participant (side=consumer) of each listed session.
